name: Hornero Disk Usage
description: Disk Usage 2.0: dashboard card over the shared PluginKit System.disks facade with per-disk used/total/free space, a most-full summary and near-full alerts. No invented SMART data. Read-only.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Per-disk card on the shared System.disks facade: used/total/free in correct KiB units, most-full summary, near-full alerts, typed settings and Spanish catalog. No SMART data invented.
Dashboard card listing mounted disks with used/total space and a percentage bar.

warnPercent.description: Used percent at or above which a disk is flagged as nearly full.

showFreeSpace.description: Show free space under each disk (additive in 2.0) and the nearly-full hint.
